diagnoses.description: CSV report generator only writes the output file when at least one HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerability is found; when none are found it prints a message and exits without creating `/root/security_audit.csv`. This violates the task guidance to still write a valid CSV (header-only) for zero findings.

Skills map Trivy's `VulnerabilityID` directly into the `CVE_ID` column without enforcing CVE formatting or performing GHSA→CVE mapping. Trivy can emit non-CVE IDs (e.g., GHSA-*), which would violate the task contract requiring a CVE ID per row when a mapping exists / prioritizing CVE-providing sources.

locations.section: ## Field Mapping from JSON to CSV

diagnoses.description: Examples use relative paths (`package-lock.json`, `security_audit.csv`) instead of the task-required absolute paths (`/root/package-lock.json`, `/root/security_audit.csv`). Following these instructions can scan the wrong file and/or write the CSV to the wrong location.
